source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations"); Banbridge Chronicle, 14 June 1952, p. 6 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Banbridge, election of rural district councillors, 1952")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the 20 electoral divisions of Banbridge rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-one nominations were lodged; the only contest was at Skeagh, and the other nineteen members were returned unopposed (returning officer's notice of result, Banbridge Chronicle, 14 June 1952, p. 6; round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
